issues: BackupPassphraseScreen uses a weak passphrase policy (requires only two character classes) but the spec requires at least three of the four character classes (uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol) – update validatePassphrase() accordingly.

Numeric input fields (receipt amount, mileage miles, mileage rate, tax rate, etc.) lack comprehensive validation (non‑negative, proper bounds, numeric format). Implement validation in the relevant entry screens (ReceiptEntryScreen, MileageEntryScreen, TaxSettingsScreen) and disable save actions until inputs are valid.

Photo capture (src/lib/photoPicker.ts) does not enforce a maximum image size or resolution, allowing arbitrarily large files that could exhaust device storage – add size/resolution limits or down‑scale images before storing.
feedback: The core data handling, encryption, backup/restore, CSV/PDF export, and policy gate are correctly implemented and pass all acceptance tests. However, key security and usability requirements are missing: the backup passphrase policy is insufficient, numeric inputs are not validated as required, and image size constraints are absent. Address these issues to fully meet the task specifications.
